**The problem / use case**
What are you trying to do that's hard or impossible today?

**Proposed capability**
What tool or behavior would help.

**Is it a server primitive or agent orchestration?**
This project keeps deterministic transforms in the server and leaves judgment/orchestration
to the calling agent. Does this need to live in the server, or can an agent do it over the
existing tools? (See DESIGN.md §10b.)

**Alternatives / notes**
Anything else — including whether the Google Docs/Drive API even supports it.
